summary: Prepare customer documentation independently from OSS releases using the existing canonical release notes and stable page impact metadata.
userImpact: Documentation preparation failures do not prevent an otherwise qualified software release.
configuration: Configure DOCUMENTATION_UPDATE_TOKEN only for the independent private documentation workflow handoff.
security: Canonical published Markdown, GitHub release identity and source commit are checked before private draft preparation; customer publication retains its own approval gates.

customerDocumentation.reason: This change enforces maintainer publication controls without changing application tasks or runtime contracts.

knownLimitations: Private CMS export/draft storage and documentation publisher environments need configuration before hosted preparation and publication.
rollback: Revert the control-flow change through reviewed protected source; no runtime or database rollback is required.
validation: Local release-note, detached handoff, canonical equality, idempotence, failed-delivery and publication-authorization regression checks.
